Business Unit
The S1 Legal & Administration Line functions as the backbone support system for corporate security, legal affairs, government affairs, administrative affairs, procurement, infrastructure, and corporate social responsibility.

What the Role Entails
About the job
Tencent is a world-leading internet and technology company that develops innovative products and services to improve the quality of life of people around the world. Founded in 1998 with its headquarters in Shenzhen China, our guiding principle is to use technology for good.
We are not only a major video game publisher in the world, we also produce other high-quality digital content, enriching interactive entertainment experiences for people around the globe. Develop and implement program to facilitate compliance with international data privacy and personal information collection rules, regulations and standards, including the GDPR, CCPA and PDPO/ PDPA.
Manage and coordinate outside counsel for all privacy law projects.
Draft, review, negotiate and administer legal and commercial documentations.
Analyse global privacy legal requirements and keep our stakeholders abreast of all new privacy laws and regulations that may have implications to Tencent.

Able to work independently while contributing effectively in a team environment.

Experience in conducting data privacy reviews of products, including ROPs, PIA and TIAs, to ensure compliance with global privacy regulations and internal policies.
Demonstrated experience in working closely with business teams and technical teams throughout the product lifecycle.
Strong interest in the internet, gaming, cloud services and AI space.
Proven track record in problem solving, analytical and organizational skills.
Proactive approach and able to handle matters independently.
Sound interpersonal and communication skills.
Excellent written and spoken English and Chinese (Mandarin) to interact with stakeholders in China HQ and other regions.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

metadata.RecruitPostName: AI Infra强化学习工程师-深圳/北京/上海
metadata.Responsibility:
1.负责LLM RL、Agentic RL强化学习训练框架的设计、开发与性能优化，支撑大规模 RL 算法（如 PPO、DQN、GRPO等）的高效落地；
2.构建分布式训练体系，优化训推异步、partial rollout、数据并行、模型并行、Replay Buffer分布式存储与调度策略，提升 GPU 利用率与训练吞吐；
3.设计并实现 RL 训练全流程工具链：包括环境封装、数据预处理、模型版本管理、训练日志监控、指标可可视化（TensorBoard/Weights & Biases）等；
4.解决 RL 训练中的工程瓶颈：如样本传输延迟、GPU 显存溢出、训练稳定性（梯度爆炸 / 消失）等问题，提供工程化解决方案；
5.与 RL 算法团队紧密协作，理解算法需求并迭代基础设施，适配多场景的训练需求；
6.跟进强化学习与分布式训练领域的前沿技术（如 VERL、rllm、Agentlightning、Ray、Megatron-LM等），并落地到实际系统中。

metadata.RecruitPostName: Data Science Intern 107259
metadata.Responsibility:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for an Associate Data Scientist to help build AI-powered capabilities for our influencer marketing platform. This role focuses on turning data and machine learning into practical product features—from creator discovery and content understanding to campaign optimization and performance prediction.
You will work at the intersection of data science, product, and engineering, helping bring intelligent systems into real world use cases that drive measurable business impact.
1. Applied AI & Model Development
Develop and deploy machine learning / AI models to enhance platform capabilities.
Work on use cases such as: 
Creator segmentation and recommendation.
Creator Content labeling and data analysis.
Campaign performance prediction and optimization. 
Agentic Systems Developing.

2. Problem Framing & Experimentation
Translate business and product problems into data science solutions.
Design experiments to validate hypotheses and measure impact.
Iterate on models based on performance, feedback, and real-world usage.

3. Data Pipeline & Feature Engineering
Work with data engineers to define and build scalable data pipelines.
Clean, process, and structure large datasets (creator data, content metadata, campaign performance).
Design meaningful features that improve model performance.

4. Product Integration
Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to integrate models into the platform.
Ensure models are production-ready, reliable, and scalable.
Contribute to API design, model serving, and inference workflows.

5. Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
Track model performance using appropriate metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, business KPIs).
Maintain documentation and ensure reproducibility.

Who We Look For
Core Values
Integrity – You prioritize correctness, transparency, and responsible use of data.
Gamer Native – You understand gaming ecosystems and player/content dynamics.
Pop Culture Fluent – You are familiar with creators, platforms, and digital trends.
Tech-Savvy – You are curious and hands-on with emerging AI technologies.

Technical Skills
Strong foundation in machine learning and statistics.
Proficiency in Python and common ML libraries (e.g., PyTorch,scikit-learn).
Experience with data processing (e.g., pandas, SQL).
Familiarity with LLMs, NLP, or recommendation systems is a strong plus.
Understanding of model deployment (APIs, batch/real-time inference) is preferred.

Data & Product Thinking
Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into data science solutions.
Strong analytical thinking and hypothesis-driven approach.
Understanding of how models create value in a product context (not just offline metrics).

Execution & Collaboration
Ability to work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and business teams.
Good communication skills—able to explain complex models in simple terms.
Strong ownership and ability to iterate quickly.

Nice to Have
Experience in influencer marketing, advertising, or creator platforms.
Familiarity with social media data (e.g., YouTube, Twitch, TikTok ecosystems).
Experience with embeddings, vector databases, or retrieval systems.
Basic knowledge of data engineering or MLOps workflows.

Example Projects You Might Work On
Build a creator discovery engine using embeddings + similarity search.
Develop a content understanding pipeline (tags, sentiment, brand safety).
Train a campaign ROI prediction model to guide budget allocation. 
Integrate LLMs to improve tool efficiency and automate workflows.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

detail.Introduction: 在腾讯，后台开发工程师不仅是“又快又稳”的问题解决专家，更是生态共创者。你将与技术团队一同沉淀优质代码，让它成为我们共有的宝贵资产。在不同的业务场景和技术发展阶段，你的架构思维也将帮助更多协作团队拓展新的思考。我们也珍视你的挑战精神，同时欢迎你一起参与团队愿景、文化和产品方向的探讨。
detail.DepartmentIntroduction:
技术架构团队缔造了微信后台的第一行代码，目前已成为集应用开发和基础研究于一身的重要部门。该团队创立了 WXG 内部开发者每日使用的 ABC（AI、BigData、Cloud）平台，其中包括 AI 应用平台、BigData 平台和 Cloud 平台。AI 应用平台承担了各项 AI 技术在具体业务中的落地功能，支持每分钟数千万次的调用。BigData 平台负责大数据分析和挖掘功能，每天支持上百万次的任务运行。Cloud 平台则负责计算和存储资源的调度功能，为庞大的在线服务系统以及 AI 和 BigData 的训练和推理任务提供支持。此外，该团队还负责微信消息系统、音视频通话、朋友圈、视频号和直播等基础功能支撑，为超过 10 亿用户的日常使用提供强有力的支持。

技术架构团队不仅负责应用开发，还致力于基础研究。该团队在 CV、ASR 和 NLP 等领域的 AI 算法预研方面表现突出，并成功将这些技术应用于实际业务。团队的研究成果被广泛运用于微信产品，提升了用户体验和产品竞争力。此外，该团队还积极参与学术交流和开源社区，持续推动着人工智能领域的发展。

metadata.RecruitPostName: Solution Architect, Big Data
metadata.Responsibility:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Role Overview
As a key member of the Tencent Cloud Big Data team, you will be responsible for technical consulting and solution implementation for key overseas accounts. This role requires a blend of deep technical expertise in big data and a keen insight into the global cloud market. You will empower global enterprises to solve complex data challenges while showcasing the unique value of Tencent Cloud against competitors like AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
Key Responsibilities
Requirement Insight & Solution Design: Deeply understand the pain points of overseas customers in big data architecture, real-time computing, and data governance. Design end-to-end solutions tailored to specific industries such as E-commerce, Gaming, and Fintech.
Customer Acquisition & Value Proposition: Lead technical exchanges and Proof of Concept (PoC) for major overseas clients. Effectively communicate the core advantages of Tencent Cloud’s big data suite to drive cloud migration and architecture upgrades. Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as a bridge between the overseas frontline and the R&D headquarters. Collaborate with product, research, and post-sales teams to ensure client technical requests are resolved efficiently.
Product Globalization Driver: Extract common requirements from the international market (e.g., data compliance, multi-cloud strategy) to influence the product roadmap and drive the localization and optimization of Tencent Cloud products.

Who We Look For
Background: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Communications, or related fields. 5+ years of experience in Big Data; prior experience with Tier-1 Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) is highly preferred.
Expertise in the Hadoop ecosystem and deep understanding of components like Spark, Flink, Elasticsearch, Doris, ClickHouse, and Trino.,
Strong knowledge of big data architecture, including Data Lake (Iceberg, Hudi) and Serverless data concepts.
Familiarity with mainstream global cloud products such as AWS EMR/Redshift, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, and Databricks.,
Ability to perform competitive analysis and develop differentiation strategies.
Soft Skills: Excellent logical thinking, communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in a cross-cultural and high-pressure environment.
Must be capable of conducting technical presentations, writing proposals, and supporting client negotiations independently.
Proficiency in English or Chinese is required as a working language.
Experience in overseas study or supporting international projects is a significant plus.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: France-Paris | United Kingdom

metadata.RecruitPostName: Tencent Cloud- Big Data Migration Architect (Malaysia)
metadata.Responsibility:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
1. Migration Architecture Design & Hands-on Implementation:
Design architecture migration solutions for public cloud customers. Focus on deep technical implementation for migrating overseas mainstream stacks (BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.) to Tencent Cloud WeData + DLC/EMR (storage-compute separation architecture). Deploy migration environments, execute data synchronization, and perform business cutovers on the front line.
2. End-to-End Project Management & Delivery: Take ownership of the overall project schedule, risk control, and technical solution governance. Coordinate internal and external resources to overcome organizational and technical barriers, ensuring the successful final delivery of the migration project.
3. Process Assurance & Technical Support: Act as the primary technical point of contact for troubleshooting and resolving complex issues during migration. Ensure a fast and smooth transition to the cloud by managing data consistency, business continuity, and providing comprehensive technical guidance.
4. Deep Technical Optimization: Provide full-stack technical support, including but not limited to SQL syntax automated conversion/rewriting, Spark/Flink operator tuning, and post-migration performance benchmarking. Ensure that business performance on Tencent Cloud meets or exceeds expectations.
5. Product-Research Collaboration & Best Practices: Work closely with Solution Architects (SA) to professionally summarize and feed back real-world customer requirements, pain points, and tool defects. Assist SAs in refining migration roadmaps and co-authoring "Best Practice Manuals" for migrating from overseas cloud platforms to Tencent Cloud.

Who We Look For
1. Hardcore Technical Background: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science or related fields; 5+ years of experience in Big Data. Proficient in at least one programming language (Java, Scala, or Python) with strong coding skills and logic conversion capabilities.
2. Overseas Stack Expertise: Familiar with the architecture and use cases of at least one major product: BigQuery, Databricks, or Snowflake. Understand the differences between these and open-source ecosystems (Spark, Hive); cross-cloud migration experience is a plus.
3. System Analysis & Large-scale Management: Strong capability in system problem analysis and resolving complex architectural issues. Proven experience in cluster performance tuning, troubleshooting, source code optimization, and version upgrades; experience managing large-scale clusters (1000+ nodes) is preferred.
4. Migration Delivery Experience: Extensive experience in Big Data migration implementation and management. Master common migration workflows and methodologies for big data components. Familiar with mainstream vendor platforms and a proven track record of delivering large-scale cloud migration projects (PB-level).
5. Core Component Principles: Deep understanding of the Hadoop ecosystem, with source-code level or deep tuning experience in HDFS, Yarn, Spark, Hive, Flink, Doris, Iceberg/Hudi, etc. Capable of handling underlying compatibility issues in heterogeneous environments.
6. Soft Skills & Professionalism: Excellent customer service awareness, communication, and resource coordination skills. Proactive, self-driven, and highly responsible. Able to thrive under pressure in cross-cloud and overseas migration scenarios.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Malaysia-Kuala Lumpur

metadata.RecruitPostName: WXG - Data Scientist Intern (Safety Strategies) 107551
metadata.Responsibility:
Business Unit
WeiXin Group(WXG) is responsible for the construction and operation of the Weixin ecosystem and leveraging Weixin's open platforms such as Official Accounts, Mini Programs, Weixin Pay, WeCom and search function. WXG provides solutions and connectivity for intelligent upgrades across all industries. WXG is also responsible for the development and operation of QQ Mail, WeRead and other products.

What the Role Entails
Participate in designing safe processes and managing safety rules to ensure account safety while improving the safety experience
Analyse behavioural trends to identify malicious activities and detect anomalies in the WeChat ecosystem via data analysis and machine learning
Devise appropriate strategies to track fraudulent accounts and protect users from spam or fraudulent activity
Deploy and maintain machine learned models to help detect malicious accounts

Who We Look For
Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
Ability to communicate complex ideas to non-technical stakeholders in a way they can easily understand and appreciate.
Experience on building machine learning or deep learning solutions
Good knowledge of Python programming language, C/C++/Go programming language is preferred
Self-driven, innovative, collaborative, with good communication and presentation skills, able to translate between business and technical audiences
Fluency in both English and Mandarin to deal with international stakeholders and stakeholders who are based in HQ

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

metadata.RecruitPostName: Senior Data Center Operations Engineer
metadata.Responsibility:
Business Unit
Technology Engineering Group (TEG) is responsible for supporting the company and its business groups on technology and operational platforms, as well as the construction and operation of R&D management and data centers, TEG provides users with a full range of customer services. As the operator of the largest networking, devices, and data center in Asia,TEG also leads the Tencent Technology Committee in strengthening infrastructure R&D through internal and distributed open source collaboration, constructing new platforms and supporting business innovation.

What the Role Entails
1）Contribute to Tencent’s overseas data center strategy in line with company and departmental objectives; oversee local management of overseas data centers, including site selection, construction, and operations to ensure quality, efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and security.
2）Manage IT operations for overseas data centers, including IT maintenance, relocation, decommissioning, warehousing, asset management, operational safety, and service management, while building and maintaining relevant processes and documentation; support IDC-related compliance certifications.
3）Manage relationships with overseas data center and network operators, building strong partnerships to ensure secure and reliable operations.
4）Oversee and evaluate on-site operations outsourcing partners and teams.
5）Drive the development of the overseas IDC ecosystem.

Who We Look For
1）Bachelor’s degree or above, with 5+ years of experience in data center infrastructure or networking.
2）Proficiency in both Chinese and English (written and spoken), with the ability to communicate effectively with international stakeholders. Prior overseas work experience preferred.
3）Familiar with IDC infrastructure architecture and mainstream infrastructure systems/equipment; knowledge of overseas operator internal operation mechanisms. CDCP certification and familiarity with overseas IDC or network ecosystem resources are a plus.
4）Knowledge of mainstream data center servers and networking equipment; understanding of IT hardware fundamentals, internet interconnection technologies, and overseas operator collaboration models. Broad relevant experience preferred.
5）Strong operational service management skills, with knowledge of mainstream IT management frameworks. ITIL certification preferred.
6）Strong communication, project management, and coordination skills, with hands-on experience in overseas IDC project management. PMP certification preferred.
7）Steady and composed personality, meticulous yet bold in execution; strong sense of responsibility, high learning agility, and strong team spirit.
8）Able to travel overseas as required for project construction or operational needs; must demonstrate strong stress resilience and self-adjustment ability.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

metadata.RecruitPostName: 混元Agent后训练算法工程师（北京/上海/深圳）
metadata.Responsibility:
1.Agent 后训练算法设计与实现：主导基模大模型的 Agent 化后训练方案研发，包括指令微调（SFT）、奖励模型（RM）训练、强化学习（RLHF/RLAIF）优化，聚焦任务规划、记忆机制、工具调用、多轮对话一致性等核心能力提升。​；
2.后训练数据体系构建：设计 Agent 后训练数据的采集、清洗、标注与迭代策略，涵盖通用指令集、任务型对话数据、工具调用样本、多模态交互数据等，建立数据质量评估与筛选机制，优化数据分布与多样性。​；
3.Agent 能力优化与突破：针对 Agent 在复杂任务拆解、跨领域知识迁移、动态环境适配等场景的痛点，研发创新后训练算法（如分层任务规划训练、多智能体协作训练、反幻觉优化），提升 Agent 的决策准确性与鲁棒性。​；
4.工程化落地与系统协作：搭建高高效后训练流水线，支持大规模数据并行处理、分布式训练（DDP/FSDP）与模型压缩部署；与产品、工程团队协作，打通 “后训练 - 评测 - 迭代” 闭环，适配不同场景下的 Agent 产品需求。​；
5.技术创新与沉淀：跟踪大模型 Agent 领域前沿技术（如 LLM+Planning、Tool Learning、Multi-Agent Interaction），主导核心技术攻关与专利申请；输出可复用的后训练算法组件、技术文档与评测基准，推动团队技术能力沉淀。

1.负责TokenHub模型资源的日常运营管理，包括自建资源、外采模型、不同供应商资源的接入、分配、监控与优化；
2.结合业务需求、客户Pipeline、模型调用量和成本变化，推动资源供给规划，保障重点客户和核心场景的容量稳定；
3.跟踪不同模型、不同供应商的价格、性能、稳定性和服务质量，形成资源选择、采购、调度和替换建议；
4.建立Token资源运营看板，持续监控调用量、TPM、成本、毛利、利用率、故障率、限流情况等关键指标；
5.协同产品、研发、销售、交付、财务等团队，支持客户报价、资源评估、容量承诺、成本测算和经营分析；
6.推动资源运营流程标准化，包括供应商管理、容量申请、资源调拨、异常响应、成本复盘和月度经营盘点。

metadata.RecruitPostName: 魔方工作室-视频模型数据工程师
metadata.Responsibility:
1.数据策略与配比：制定预训练 / 微调 / 对齐各阶段的数据配方（domain、动作类别、画质、时长、分辨率分布），用实验驱动配比决策；
2.大规模数据管线：设计并落地视频数据的采集、去重、清洗、镜头分割、质量过滤、标注与版本管理流程，保障可复现与可追溯；
3.标注体系设计：定义动作/交互的标签体系（刺激-反应分类、轨迹、物件、深度等），制定标注规范与质检抽样方案，管理标注质量；
4.控制信号对齐：建立 caption、轨迹、首末帧、深度/mask 等条件信号与视频帧的对齐与质检指标，量化对齐误差对生成效果的影响；
5.评测与归因：构建画质、时序一致性、身份保持、控制响应等离线评测集与指标，做数据-效果归因分析，定位"哪类数据缺失导致哪类 bad case"；
6.数据质量度量：定义并监控数据集的覆盖度、多样性、噪声率、长尾分布等指标，建立数据健康度看板。

detail.DepartmentIntroduction:
腾讯云，腾讯倾力打造的云服务品牌，为客户提供先进的云产品与云服务。依托各地的数据中心，我们将云计算、大数据、人工智能、物联网、安全等先进技术与智慧产业业务场景相结合，同时面向金融、教育、医疗、零售、制造与消费电子、交通、能源与资源、广电、文旅、建筑与地产、农业、体育、运营商等领域，打造全面的智慧行业解决方案。目前，腾讯云在助力产业数字化方面取得了丰富的实践经验，为众多优秀的企业提供优质服务，帮助他们实现数字化和智慧化升级。加入我们，一起“产业智变，云启未来”！

对应的产品包括：数据库、大数据、音视频、计算、存储、网络、云智能与AI产品、腾讯会议、腾讯企点、企业中台SaaS等；

metadata.RecruitPostName: 微信安全-大模型安全高级工程师
metadata.Responsibility:
1.安全体系规划与建设：主导大模型内容安全风控的策略规划，系统性地构建覆盖风险识别、评估、处置与迭代的闭环安全体系，制定模型安全准入规范与基线标准；
2.前沿安全技术研究与落地：深入研究大模型及智能体的安全机制，攻克提示词注入、数据投毒、模型幻觉、隐私泄露等安全难题，设计安全对齐、安全推理与防御方案，推动从研究到产品落地的全链路转化；
3.安全攻防能力建设：构建自动化红队评测与蓝队防御体系，开发安全评估工具与测试框架，建立安全评估基准与持续回归测试机制，实现攻防闭环迭代；
4.全链路策略优化：通过数据驱动的方法，深度分析安全策略效果，持续优化风险识别精度与效率，主导策略从验证到全量上线的完整生命周期管理；
5.安全架构设计：主导大模型架构安全方案设计，覆盖向量数据库安全、Agent应用安全、AI接口与调用链路安全、模型水印与溯源等关键环节；
6.行业洞察与合规：保持对全球大模型安全领域技术动态与合规政策（生成式AI合规、数据安全、个人信息保护等）的敏锐洞察，将前沿成果与合规要求转化为提升产品安全竞争力的有效实践。

metadata.RecruitPostName: Data & AI Analytics Intern 107767
metadata.Responsibility:
Business Unit
WeiXin Group(WXG) is responsible for the construction and operation of the Weixin ecosystem and leveraging Weixin's open platforms such as Official Accounts, Mini Programs, Weixin Pay, WeCom and search function. WXG provides solutions and connectivity for intelligent upgrades across all industries. WXG is also responsible for the development and operation of QQ Mail, WeRead and other products.

What the Role Entails
About WeChat
With over 1.3 billion users worldwide, WeChat is shaping the future of digital communication by connecting people, services, and businesses across the globe. The WeChat operations team offers a unique opportunity to redefine how users engage with mobile technology while gaining valuable insights into global user behavior and preferences. Based in Singapore, our team is responsible for managing and expanding WeChat’s core product offerings, including messaging and social networking, for users outside the Chinese mainland. Join us in making a meaningful impact by keeping millions of people connected through one of the world's most influential digital platforms.
About the Internship
WeChat’s internships provide paid, full-time opportunities lasting a minimum of 12 weeks. Interns will be mentored by senior members of the WeChat operations team and work hands-on in developing new projects and product features. By the end of the internship, participants will have gained a deep understanding of WeChat’s values, independently executed data-driven projects, and collaborated effectively across multiple departments, including product, engineering, and legal teams.

Why Join Us?
Gain hands-on experience with large-scale data in a leading global tech company
Work with cutting-edge technologies and experienced mentors in a dynamic environment
Be part of an impact-driven team that shapes digital communication worldwide
Responsibilities
Analyze large-scale datasets to identify business opportunities, detect patterns, and optimize product performance across the platform.
Develop data dashboards and visualization tools to track key performance metrics and provide actionable product insights.
Design and build scalable data pipelines to support analytics, operational decision-making, and platform security initiatives.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (product, engineering, operations, and security teams) to translate analytical findings into business strategies and product improvements.
Leverage AI-powered tools and technologies (e.g., LLMs, AI copilots, data assistants) to enhance analysis efficiency, automate workflows, and improve decision accuracy while maintaining robust traditional data engineering and analytics practices.
Explore and integrate AI-driven methodologies to optimize analytical processes, including automated data exploration, report generation, and intelligent insight discovery.

Who We Look For
Requirements
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
Strong experience in data analytics and data engineering, including building data pipelines, statistical analysis, and data visualization.
Proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience working with large-scale data platforms (e.g., Hive, Spark, or similar big data environments).
Experience building data dashboards and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Superset, or similar platforms).
Familiarity with AI-assisted data analysis tools, including prompt engineering, context engineering, and AI workflow integration.
Experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), AI agents, MCP frameworks, or similar AI infrastructure is a strong plus.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex problems into structured analytical approaches.
Excellent learning ability, curiosity for new technologies, and a strong sense of ownership and self-driven execution.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

Business Unit

WXG provides solutions and connectivity for intelligent upgrades across all industries. WXG is also responsible for the development and operation of QQ Mail, WeRead and other products.

What the Role Entails
About WeChat
With over 1.3 billion users worldwide, WeChat is shaping the future of digital communication by connecting people, services, and businesses across the globe. The WeChat operations team offers a unique opportunity to redefine how users engage with mobile technology while gaining valuable insights into global user behavior and preferences. Based in Singapore, our team is responsible for managing and expanding WeChat’s core product offerings, including messaging and social networking, for users outside the Chinese mainland. Join us in making a meaningful impact by keeping millions of people connected through one of the world's most influential digital platforms.
About the Internship
WeChat’s internships provide paid, full-time opportunities lasting a minimum of 12 weeks. Interns will be mentored by senior members of the WeChat operations team and work hands-on in developing new projects and product features. By the end of the internship, participants will have gained a deep understanding of WeChat’s values, independently executed data-driven projects, and collaborated effectively across multiple departments, including product, engineering, and legal teams.

Why Join Us?
Gain hands-on experience with large-scale data in a leading global tech company
Work with cutting-edge technologies and experienced mentors in a dynamic environment
Be part of an impact-driven team that shapes digital communication worldwide
Responsibilities
Analyze large-scale datasets to identify business opportunities, detect patterns, and optimize product performance across the platform.
Develop data dashboards and visualization tools to track key performance metrics and provide actionable product insights.
Design and build scalable data pipelines to support analytics, operational decision-making, and platform security initiatives.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (product, engineering, operations, and security teams) to translate analytical findings into business strategies and product improvements.
Leverage AI-powered tools and technologies (e.g., LLMs, AI copilots, data assistants) to enhance analysis efficiency, automate workflows, and improve decision accuracy while maintaining robust traditional data engineering and analytics practices.
Explore and integrate AI-driven methodologies to optimize analytical processes, including automated data exploration, report generation, and intelligent insight discovery.

Who We Look For
Requirements
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
Strong experience in data analytics and data engineering, including building data pipelines, statistical analysis, and data visualization.
Proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience working with large-scale data platforms (e.g., Hive, Spark, or similar big data environments).
Experience building data dashboards and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Superset, or similar platforms).
Familiarity with AI-assisted data analysis tools, including prompt engineering, context engineering, and AI workflow integration.
Experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), AI agents, MCP frameworks, or similar AI infrastructure is a strong plus.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex problems into structured analytical approaches.
Excellent learning ability, curiosity for new technologies, and a strong sense of ownership and self-driven execution.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

metadata.RecruitPostName: Agent Security Expert
metadata.Responsibility:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
We are building the next-generation Agent security product to protect enterprise AI workloads at scale. As our Agent Security Expert, you will define the technical architecture for real-time agent defense and lead the product's security roadmap in a fast-emerging global market. You will work at the intersection of application security, AI safety, and systems engineering, shaping how enterprises safely deploy autonomous agents across their digital infrastructure.Own the end-to-end technical architecture of our Agent security product, making principled trade-offs across detection coverage, latency, and operational overhead.
Design and implement runtime guardrails — including prompt injection defense, unauthorized tool-call interception, behavioral drift detection, and real-time credential leak prevention.
Architect MCP and tool-chain supply-chain security capabilities against tool poisoning, cross-origin privilege escalation, and transitive trust abuse.
Build an automated agent red-teaming pipeline to continuously discover vulnerabilities, generate adversarial test cases, and harden defenses before production deployment.
Partner with product, engineering, and threat intelligence teams to translate emerging attack patterns into shipped security features, and mentor junior engineers on security-first design.

Who We Look For
8+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, systems engineering, or a closely related field, with a track record of shipping production security components.
Deep expertise in at least two of: application security, cloud-native security, identity and access management (IAM), or offensive/defensive security operations.
Proficient in at least two of Go, Python, Rust, or C++, with experience building high-concurrency security services or detection pipelines.

6、熟练使用至少一种 BI 工具（Tableau / Power BI / Metabase / Looker Studio）

Game Analytics / Firebase / PlayFab 等游戏分析工具使用经验
爬虫开发经验（Scrapy / API 接入）
游戏经济系统分析能力
A/B 测试设计与分析经验

metadata.RecruitPostName: Software Engineering Intern (Overseas AdTech Data Systems) 108000
metadata.Responsibility:
Business Unit
Corporate Development Group (CDG) as the platform for the company's new business incubation and new business exploration, CDG is responsible for promoting development and innovation for important areas such as financial technology and advertising, as well as marketing services, including payment and financial applications. As a professional support platform, CDG also supports the company and various business groups in strategic planning, investments and mergers, investor relations and corporate global communications, marketing and public relations, and more.

What the Role Entails
About Us
Tencent is a world-leading internet and technology company that develops innovative products and services to improve the quality of life of people around the world. Founded in 1998 with its headquarters in Shenzhen, China, our two guiding principles are to use technology for good and to provide value to our users. Our growth strategy is built upon attracting the best people and creating an amazing work atmosphere that balances the energy of a start-up with the resources of a global innovation leader.
Role Overview
Tencent AMS is establishing a core engineering hub in Singapore to spearhead our overseas advertising data infrastructure. We are seeking a motivated Software Engineering Intern to assist in the development of our next-generation ad-data systems natively on AWS.
This is a unique opportunity to learn and contribute to building a high-scale ecosystem from the ground up. Working alongside experienced senior engineers, you will gain hands-on experience tackling the unique challenges of high-concurrency advertising logic—such as real-time attribution and massive log processing—in a cloud-native environment.
Key Responsibilities
Cloud-Native System Development: Assist in building, testing, and maintaining advertising data services on AWS, gaining exposure to technologies like EKS, MSK, and S3.
Large-Scale Data Engineering: Participate in the development and optimization of real-time and batch processing pipelines using Flink, Spark, and HBase to handle massive ad-log flows.
System Reliability & Testing: Write robust unit and integration tests. Assist in monitoring system stability and troubleshooting basic performance bottlenecks under the guidance of senior engineers.
Feature Implementation: Collaborate with the team to implement features that support mission-critical, 24/7 ad-tech operations with high traffic and low latency.
Data Compliance: Support the team in developing technical solutions that enforce strict data isolation and regional compliance for global users.
Technical Requirements
Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Backend Foundation: Solid programming skills in Java, with a strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design. Basic knowledge of multithreading and JVM is a plus.
Big Data Interest: Academic or personal project experience with, or a strong desire to learn, big data frameworks (e.g., Flink, Spark, HBase).
Cloud/Infrastructure: Basic understanding of cloud computing concepts. Familiarity with Linux environments, Git, and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) is highly preferred.
Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills with the ability to debug code and solve complex technical problems effectively.

Who We Look For
Preferred Qualifications
AI-Assisted Development: Familiarity with AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT) and a proactive mindset to leverage them for enhancing coding efficiency, generating tests, and debugging.
Industry Interest: A strong interest in the AdTech industry (e.g., Attribution, Tracking, or RTB systems).
Drive & Passion: A passion for exploring new technologies and a proactive, self-driven approach to learning.
Professional working proficiency in English and Mandarin is required, as the role regularly involves participating in meetings and reviewing written materials in both languages with global teams and with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders at our headquarters in China.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

metadata.RecruitPostName: Tencent Cloud- Big Data Migration Architect (Malaysia)
metadata.Responsibility:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
1. Migration Architecture Design & Hands-on Implementation:
Design architecture migration solutions for public cloud customers. Focus on deep technical implementation for migrating overseas mainstream stacks (BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.) to Tencent Cloud WeData + DLC/EMR (storage-compute separation architecture). Deploy migration environments, execute data synchronization, and perform business cutovers on the front line.
2. End-to-End Project Management & Delivery: Take ownership of the overall project schedule, risk control, and technical solution governance. Coordinate internal and external resources to overcome organizational and technical barriers, ensuring the successful final delivery of the migration project.
3. Process Assurance & Technical Support: Act as the primary technical point of contact for troubleshooting and resolving complex issues during migration. Ensure a fast and smooth transition to the cloud by managing data consistency, business continuity, and providing comprehensive technical guidance.
4. Deep Technical Optimization: Provide full-stack technical support, including but not limited to SQL syntax automated conversion/rewriting, Spark/Flink operator tuning, and post-migration performance benchmarking. Ensure that business performance on Tencent Cloud meets or exceeds expectations.
5. Product-Research Collaboration & Best Practices: Work closely with Solution Architects (SA) to professionally summarize and feed back real-world customer requirements, pain points, and tool defects. Assist SAs in refining migration roadmaps and co-authoring "Best Practice Manuals" for migrating from overseas cloud platforms to Tencent Cloud.

Who We Look For
1. Hardcore Technical Background: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science or related fields; 5+ years of experience in Big Data. Proficient in at least one programming language (Java, Scala, or Python) with strong coding skills and logic conversion capabilities.
2. Overseas Stack Expertise: Familiar with the architecture and use cases of at least one major product: BigQuery, Databricks, or Snowflake. Understand the differences between these and open-source ecosystems (Spark, Hive); cross-cloud migration experience is a plus.
3. System Analysis & Large-scale Management: Strong capability in system problem analysis and resolving complex architectural issues. Proven experience in cluster performance tuning, troubleshooting, source code optimization, and version upgrades; experience managing large-scale clusters (1000+ nodes) is preferred.
4. Migration Delivery Experience: Extensive experience in Big Data migration implementation and management. Master common migration workflows and methodologies for big data components. Familiar with mainstream vendor platforms and a proven track record of delivering large-scale cloud migration projects (PB-level).
5. Core Component Principles: Deep understanding of the Hadoop ecosystem, with source-code level or deep tuning experience in HDFS, Yarn, Spark, Hive, Flink, Doris, Iceberg/Hudi, etc. Capable of handling underlying compatibility issues in heterogeneous environments.
6. Soft Skills & Professionalism: Excellent customer service awareness, communication, and resource coordination skills. Proactive, self-driven, and highly responsible. Able to thrive under pressure in cross-cloud and overseas migration scenarios.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Malaysia-Kuala Lumpur

metadata.Responsibility:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
The Product Manager, WorkBuddy Enterprise —  will own the enterprise roadmap and customer success strategy for the WorkBuddy Enterprise platform, including WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, and Managed Agents. This role drives the platform’s competitive positioning in the global enterprise AI market, covering the full lifecycle from architectural design to production-grade delivery for key enterprise customers.Define and own the enterprise product roadmap and go-to-market strategy for WorkBuddy Enterprise, driving platform competitiveness and customer adoption across international markets while aligning with business growth and commercial targets.
Lead the ecosystem and integration strategy for enterprise Skills, MCP, and Connector frameworks, enabling seamless interoperability across third-party, customer-built, and ecosystem services to support enterprise agent and digital employee deployments.
Establish reliability and evaluation (Eval) infrastructure, including eval harnesses, agent safety guardrails, trajectory replay, production telemetry, and automated regression testing, to elevate Proof of Concept success rates to production-grade standards.
Partner with sales and solutions teams to build a structured key-account delivery system, distilling implementation experience from top enterprise customers into reusable templates and best practices that accelerate time-to-value.
Manage product cost structures, resource planning, and compliance readiness across deployments, ensuring enterprise-grade data residency, tenant isolation, audit logging, and alignment with regional security and certification requirements.

Who We Look For
At least six years of product management experience, including at least three years in AI platforms, cloud platforms, developer tools, or enterprise SaaS, with a proven track record of independently owning platform products (PaaS, SDK, API, or SaaS) for enterprise customers.
Demonstrated commercial acumen with hands-on experience across the full product lifecycle, from product definition and design to go-to-market optimisation, including familiarity with ARR, gross margin, net revenue retention (NRR), and paid conversion metrics.
Deep understanding and practical use of AI and large language model products from providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, AWS, and Microsoft, together with knowledge of agent orchestration engineering and product design trade-offs.
Strong enterprise platform knowledge, including SSO, SCIM, RBAC, data residency, tenant isolation, and audit logging, with familiarity with domestic and international security compliance frameworks and certification processes.
Professional proficiency in English and Chinese, both written and verbal, is required to lead customer-facing engagements and product discussions in English with international enterprise clients, and to collaborate effectively with Chinese-speaking R&D, product, and commercial stakeholders at China headquarters.

metadata.RecruitPostName: 实时计算引擎研发工程师（深圳/上海/杭州/北京）

metadata.Responsibility:
1.Apache Flink 内核优化与二次开发：基于 Runtime、State、Checkpoint 等核心机制做深度优化与二次开发，面向高吞吐、低延迟、大状态、长周期作业专项优化，解决资源瓶颈、反压、数据倾斜、状态失效、重启抖动、延迟波动等线上核心问题；

4.前沿技术预研、社区贡献与团队赋能：跟进批流一体、增量 Checkpoint、状态 TTL、自适应调度、流式 OLAP 等前沿技术；参与 Apache Flink 社区核心研发并与全球社区共同推进 Flink 新技术方向；输出架构文档、调优规范、故障治理手册，指导初级工程师。

detail.Responsibility:

2.负责 Agentic Search 架构设计与优化，结合大语言模型、RAG、搜索排序及工具调用技术，提升复杂需求理解、商品检索、对比选购和个性化推荐效果；
3.负责大模型后训练及能力优化，包括 SFT、偏好优化、强化学习、知识蒸馏、拒绝采样、Reward 设计等，持续提升 Agent 的任务完成率、答案质量和业务转化效果。
detail.Requirement:
1.计算机、人工智能、数学、统计学或相关专业本科及以上学历，具备扎实的机器学习、深度学习和自然语言处理基础；
2.熟悉大语言模型、Agent、RAG、搜索或推荐系统中的至少一个方向，有相关算法研发或线上落地经验；

2.有 LLM Agent、大模型后训练或生成式搜索系统的实际上线经验；
3.有大规模搜索推荐系统、复杂工具调用或多智能体系统建设经验；

metadata.RecruitPostName: 混元数据与安全技术负责人（Tech Lead）（北京）
metadata.Responsibility:
1.团队管理与技术规划：统筹数据平台工程、终端安全与风控团队的技术路线规划、架构演进与团队建设，联动算法与产品团队，保障基础设施高可用、高扩展与业务安全；
2.海量数据与平台架构：全权负责高并发、高可用数据平台与调度引擎的架构设计，优化数据流水线与研发工具链，支撑海量数据量产与大模型训练/微调业务；
3.Agent 基础设施与接入标准化：主导内部 Agent 调用的统一网关与协议基建建设，适配标准模型调用接口，支撑内部 Agent 工具链（Tool Call）、自动化评测体系接入、高并发限流与全链路 Trace 审计；
4.网络流量治理与高可用防护：主导网络层与应用层异常流量识别（如海量并发请求、异常报文、恶意 API 刷量等），构建高可靠的流量清洗、策略拦截与服务高可用调度体系；
5.终端安全与运行环境感知：带队研究移动端（iOS/Android）系统底层运行机制，针对协议分析、运行时环境篡改与异常调试等行为，搭建高精度的终端真实性校验与安全防护体系。

metadata.RecruitPostName: 微信搜索-高级研究员-大模型应用搜索方向
metadata.Responsibility:

5.跟踪业界前沿进展，在生成式检索、Reasoning、Agentic Search 等方向做前瞻性技术布局，并推动成果在亿级用户产品中规模化验证。

6.积极探索并推动 Agent 在逆向分析、内存分析等方向的产品落地，提升产品安全性与可靠性。

metadata.RecruitPostName: 混元Agentic Vision算法研究员（北京/上海）(深圳)
metadata.Responsibility:
1.主导 Visual2Code 能力建设：负责多模态大语言模型在 Visual2Code 方向的核心算法研发，围绕“视觉输入—代码理解—代码生成—执行验证”完整链路，持续提升模型从界面、图表、文档、图像等视觉信息中理解结构并生成高质量代码的能力；
2.建设高质量数据体系：负责 Visual2Code 训练数据的设计、构建与迭代，包括真实数据挖掘、自动化数据合成、难度分层、质量过滤及数据配比等，建立覆盖多场景、多语言、多任务形态的数据生产与数据飞轮体系；
3.推进模型与算法创新：深入探索 Visual2Code 场景下的 SFT、强化学习、代码执行反馈、Verifier/Reward Model 等后训练方法，研究视觉理解、代码推理与执行反馈之间的协同机制，持续提升模型在复杂任务中的正确率、泛化能力与稳定性；
4.强化复杂视觉编程能力：聚焦视觉结构解析、布局理解、图表/文档理解、视觉逻辑推理以及代码生成等关键能力，提升模型从复杂视觉输入中完成结构还原、逻辑抽取、程序生成与迭代修正的能力；
5.建设系统化评测体系：搭建 Visual2Code 能力评测与诊断体系，从视觉感知、结构理解、代码正确性、执行结果、视觉还原度、复杂推理等维度建立 Benchmark 与自动化评测链路，持续定位模型能力瓶颈并指导训练迭代；
6.探索 Agentic Vision 新范式：探索视觉模型与代码执行、工具调用、环境反馈等能力的结合，推动模型从一次性 Visual2Code 生成进一步走向“理解—生成—执行—观察—修正”的 Agentic Vision 闭环，提升模型自主解决复杂视觉任务的能力。

1.需求洞察：持续追踪 Coding Agent / AI 编程助手领域的需求变化，通过用户反馈、行为数据、市场调研等多源信息，识别开发者的真实痛点、未满足需求及新兴任务形态，，输出周期性需求洞察报告；
2.UserLog 与 Agent 轨迹深度分析：对多轮对话、任务序列、工具调用和用户反馈进行深入分析，研究任务如何产生、演化和结束；识别模型在需求理解、规划、探索、执行、验证和交付等环节的困难点与失败机制；
3.用户体验与Agent行为质量的观测：从 0 到 1 设计用户体验指标体系。除满意度、留存和问题解决率外，进一步研究沉没成本、用户情绪变化、Agent 可引导性等信号，建立常态化监测机制；
4.探索性分析与假设验证：运用统计分析、聚类、大模型等方法，从海量用户数据中发现未被分类体系覆盖的新问题和新机会，主动提出「可能是什么问题 / 机会」的猜想，并设计验证方案去证实或证伪；
5.数据看板与归因：搭建核心指标看板，持续跟踪关键指标变化，对异常波动进行归因分析，定位问题根因并给出改进建议；
6.策略输入：将洞察转化为可执行的产品策略、模型优化方向和数据建设优先级，协助识别高价值训练样本、评测题、失败 Case、Rubric、Skill 等；
7.跨团队协作：与算法、产品、工程团队紧密配合，推动洞察结论在产品中落地，并跟踪落地效果形成闭环。
detail.Requirement:
1.2年以上数据分析 / 策略分析 / 市场洞察相关经验，具备扎实的数据分析功底，有产品数据科学、计算社会科学或消费者洞察背景优先；
2.熟练使用 SQL、Python（Pandas 等），能独立完成数据提取、清洗、分析与可视化，有 AI / Coding Agent / 开发者工具 / SaaS 产品相关经验者优先；
3.具备敏锐的市场洞察力与需求分析能力，能从数据和用户反馈中提炼出有说服力的结论，有用户满意度指标体系（NPS / CSAT / 留存）搭建与运营经验；
4.有指标体系设计与数据看板建设经验，能够使用包括大模型在内的分析工具提升效率，具备独立检查报告可靠性与正确性的能力。
detail.Introduction: 渴望为世界带来新意的人，早已对描绘未来的“热词”不陌生——人工智能、机器学习、数据科学等等。腾讯始终在业界前沿不断探索，积极布局，并为优秀的你提供无限广阔的舞台。我们坚信科技的不断革新，最终能带来美好的、撼动人心的改变。

metadata.RecruitPostName: Agent开发工程师
metadata.Responsibility:
团队介绍
腾讯游戏商务部的主旨是建立腾讯与全球优质厂商的桥梁，服务与全球100+投资伙伴和重要厂商。持续扩大腾讯在全球互联网生态和游戏行业的影响力，利用敏锐的嗅觉捕捉高潜力商业合作机会，并帮助投资伙伴持续的成长。深耕亚太、欧美和新兴市场，与日本、韩国、美国、英国、法国、芬兰、德国等成熟市场和东南亚、中东、土耳其等新区域的伙伴建立了深度的战略合作关系，实现商业上的共赢。
商务部期待全球的优秀人才一同加入，通过全球的优质人才网络巩固和扩大腾讯与全球合作伙伴的合作关系，并为市场孵化更多优质的游戏产品。

岗位职责
1.负责部门 Agent 产品研发，与业务、Agent 产品及运营团队紧密合作，将业务需求转化为可实现、可验证、可量化的技术方案，承担架构设计、前后端开发、测试、部署及持续迭代的完整闭环。2.负责 Agent 核心能力建设，包括企业知识库、RAG、记忆系统、工具调用、业务 Agent、MCP，以及 Multi-Agent 与人机协作流程的设计和实施。
3.负责 Agent 与腾讯内部基础设施及产品的集成，包括模型与 Agent 平台、权限身份体系、知识库及数据平台，并通过 API、SDK、MCP等方式建设稳定、可复用的连接能力。
4.建设部门 Agent Benchmark、评测与可观测体系，通过自动化评测、回归测试、Tracing、日志监控和反馈闭环，持续优化任务成功率、生成质量、稳定性、响应速度及成本。
5.建设生产级工程与安全保障体系，包括 CI/CD、自动化测试、灰度发布、故障恢复、权限控制、操作审计和数据隔离，保障 Agent 产品安全稳定运行。

岗位要求
1.本科及以上学历，5 年以上软件研发经验，具备复杂系统或产品从0到1交付经验；能力和作品突出者可适当放宽。2.熟练掌握 JavaScript/TypeScript，熟悉 React 或 Vue 中至少一种主流前端框架。熟练使用 Python、Go、Java或基于 Node.js 的服务端开发技术，熟悉 API、数据库、缓存及异步任务，具备独立全栈交付能力。3.理解 Agent Loop、Memory、Tool Calling、RAG、MCP、Planning及 Multi-Agent 等技术，并具备实际 Agent 项目开发或生产落地经验。4.具备良好的工程、产品和跨团队协作能力，重视代码质量、测试、可观测性、安全性及上线结果，能够熟练使用 AI Coding 工具提升研发效率。加分项
生产级 Agent、开发者工具或企业知识助手的落地经验。
企业知识图谱、agent/LLM评测或反馈数据闭环经验。
企业数据库系统建设，多来源数据库治理经验。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会
在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。
Work Location: China-Shenzhen

metadata.RecruitPostName: Data Science Intern 107974
metadata.Responsibility:
Business Unit
Tencent Games was established in 2003. We are a leading global platform for game development, operations and publishing, and the largest online game community in China.
Tencent Games has developed and operated over 140 games. We provide cross-platform interactive entertainment experience for more than 800 million users in over 200 countries and regions around the world. Honor of Kings, PUBG MOBILE, and League of Legends, are some of our most popular titles around the world.
Meanwhile, we actively promote the development of esports industry, work with global partners to build an open, collaborative and symbiotic industrial ecology, and create high-quality digital life experiences for players.

What the Role Entails
Analyze large-scale datasets to solve complex business and technical challenges in gaming through analytics, forecasting, machine learning, recommender systems, generative AI, experimentation, causal inference, and econometrics.
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to develop data-driven strategies and implement solutions that enhance business value.
Deliver actionable business insights to internal and external stakeholders.
Develop and maintain robust data scraping and collection pipelines (web crawling, API ingestion, data wrangling) to gather competitive intelligence, market signals, and player/community data at scale.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in data science, machine learning, and generative AI, utilizing these technologies to innovate in gaming applications.
Engage in technical knowledge sharing, documentation, and cross-team collaboration.

Who We Look For
Pursuing a M.S., or Ph.D. degree in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Math, Economics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, etc.
Experience in statistical analysis (probabilities, hypothesis testing, multivariate analysis, time series analysis, predictive modeling, A/B experiments, etc.).
Experience with building complex data products and machine learning systems on large datasets preferred.
Proficient in Python and SQL.Solid understanding of modern AI/LLM and hands-on experience applying them to real-world problems is a plus
Excellent communication, collaboration, execution capabilities, and keen business acumen.
Passionate about games and the gaming industry. Gaming experiences in FPS/TPS titles is a plus.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

detail.DepartmentIntroduction: 腾讯安全平台部成立于2005年，聚焦于腾讯内部安全防护工作，并致力于通过先进技术的应用，构建高效的安全能力协作平台，涉及的领域包含反入侵、漏洞扫描、DDoS防护、流量安全、数据安全、风控安全、安全大数据、AI安全等领域，守护数十亿用户安全，保障腾讯全线业务稳定运营，并积极向业界开放安全经验和能力，推动共建安全生态。在这里，我们用技术聚合向善的力量，不断实现技术人生的追求和梦想。

metadata.RecruitPostName: AI安全蓝军高级工程师
metadata.Responsibility:
1.负责公司核心业务与 AI 场景的安全评估和对抗演练，从安全研究视角发现真实风险，通过渗透测试、漏洞挖掘、风险验证和场景化演练等方式，持续发现安全防御体系中的薄弱环节，并推动风险闭环；

5.跟踪国内外前沿安全与 AI 技术发展，快速分析新漏洞、新型风险及 AI 安全问题，通过技术研究、原型验证和工程化落地，将前沿技术转化为实际安全能力；
6.与业务、安全研发、算法及平台团队紧密协作，对发现的问题进行风险分析和技术路径还原，帮助业务准确理解问题的实际影响，并推动高风险问题完成修复和体系化治理。

metadata.RecruitPostName: CDG - Overseas Ads Data Strategy Product Manager
metadata.Responsibility:
Business Unit
Corporate Development Group (CDG) as the platform for the company's new business incubation and new business exploration, CDG is responsible for promoting development and innovation for important areas such as financial technology and advertising, as well as marketing services, including payment and financial applications. As a professional support platform, CDG also supports the company and various business groups in strategic planning, investments and mergers, investor relations and corporate global communications, marketing and public relations, and more.

What the Role Entails
Support data analysis for the overseas ad network, leveraging industry and advertiser insights to identify growth and efficiency opportunities, and help optimize advertiser campaign performance;
Collaborate with Data Science and Recommendation teams on multi-source data analysis, contributing to the design and rollout of strategy optimizations while building reusable methodologies;
Contribute to the development of the in-house data diagnostics platform, helping build monitoring and attribution modules across the full ad-delivery funnel to improve issue diagnosis and decision-making efficiency.

Who We Look For
Bachelor in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or Business Analytics preferred;
1–2 years of working experience in the advertising industry or data science, with understanding of ad recommendation systems; prior experience in data analysis or strategy for gaming products is a plus；
Strong learning ability, curiosity about data and business, solid cross-functional collaboration skills, resilience under pressure, and a result-driven mindset;
Fluent in both English and Mandarin, able to support cross-regional communication and collaboration.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

1.实时交互视频与 AI 体验设计：负责基于实时交互视频生成模型（如：实时可交互的游戏视频，双工AI 数字人等）的产品设计与探索；针对“轻度/低动态（如数字人自由对话、AI陪伴）”及“高动态（如强交互视频、AI 游戏沙盒原型）”场景，设计顺畅、低延迟、高度符合物理与情感常识的互动流程；
2.用户洞察与场景定义：深入洞察 2C/UGC 用户的心理与互动需求，挖掘实时视频生成在娱乐、社交、互动游戏及个人陪伴等方向的应用场景；抽象并定义 AI Native产品的核心机制与表达方式，打造具备粘性与传播力的创新体验；
3.项目管理与端到端落地：跨部门打通算法、工程、数据、美术与设计团队，制定清晰的产品 Roadmap 与 Milestone，推进从 Demo 验证（PoC）到 MVP 上线及持续迭代的全流程；跟踪实时生成模型的关键指标（如端到端推理延迟、生成 FPS、画面连续性/时空一致性、因果控制力等），持续推动体验优化。

detail.Requirement:
1.基本资质与背景：本科及以上学历，计算机、人机交互（HCI）、数字媒体艺术、游戏设计、计算艺术或海内外知名院校互动/AI 产品相关专业者优先；
2.AIGC与交互产品经验：具备完整的 AIGC 产品设计经验，熟知扩散模型（Diffusion）、DiT 架构、大语言模型（LLM）及 Agent 交互的基本逻辑；有实际落地的 AI 生成类、实时交互视频类或 AI 数字人产品经验者优先；
3.项目管理与工程敏捷度：具备优秀的项目管理能力，能敏锐平衡前沿技术的不确定性（如大模型幻觉、生成延迟）与产品体验的确定性，具备强抗压能力与工程推进力；
4.游戏与创意加分项：有独立游戏（Indie Game）制作经验或传统游戏策划/设计经验者优先。理解游戏心流、数值/规则框架与关卡设计逻辑；具备极强的审美敏锐度与人机交互敏感度，对技术突破与玩法融合有极高的热情。
detail.Introduction: “用户为本，科技向善”，是写在每位腾讯产品人心中的一句箴言。在互联网浪潮中，大众的生活已被深刻地改变，如何为用户创造价值、创造怎样的价值，需要每位产品人花费更长时间去体会与探索。在这里，你将与同样关注细节、关注本质、关注美好的同事一道，开启你的创造性工作。

metadata.RecruitPostName: 智能体-资深客户端测试工程师
metadata.Responsibility:
1.负责腾讯自研 WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy / Miora 等智能体产品客户端与移动端 APP 的质量保障工作，覆盖 Windows / macOS / Android / iOS 及小程序多端形态，推动端侧质量体系建设；
2.负责客户端多维度测试体系的设计与持续演进，覆盖功能测试、兼容性测试、稳定性测试、专项测试与灰度验证，构建端到端自动化测试能力；
3.主导客户端性能与稳定性专项治理，聚焦内存、CPU、启动耗时、渲染卡顿、白屏、进程崩溃、耗电与包体积等核心指标，建立可量化的性能基线与发布门禁；
4.针对 AI 智能体在端侧的特性（流式输出、长会话上下文、Session 管理、沙箱执行、插件与扩展加载）设计深水区测试场景，前置暴露运行态风险；
5.建设客户端自动化测试 Infra 与质量数据看板，打通 Crash / ANR / 性能日志与线上舆情，将线上问题反哺为回归用例，推动质量左移与研发效能提升。

metadata.RecruitPostName: WorkBuddy-Agent Harness 算法工程师
metadata.Responsibility:
1.负责 WorkBuddy Harness 的整体效果与能力优化，协同内部团队，以用户真实任务表现为反馈，不断优化迭代 Harness 效果；岗位为研究和工程复合型，可以偏向其中一个方向，但需要对另一个方向有所了解，更倾向于两者兼顾；
2.独立解决问题，提出原创性想法，从 0 到 1 驱动研究探索；同时拥有扎实的工程落地能力，打通从想法提出到落地实现的完整链路；
3.可针对全新问题定义合理的评测与验证标准，搭建配套评测数据集；立足真实业务场景，保证智能体能力在现实环境下有效可用；
4.包括但不限于以下研究方向：1）Harness Self‑Evolution 方向：研究 Harness 闭环自进化机制，自主迭代工具集、执行架构与多智能体协作范式，适配模型能力与业务场景演进；2）Context Engineering 方向：探索复杂场景下的上下文组织与编排，在模型窗口和 token efficiency 约束下引导模型聚焦关键信息，提升 Agent 任务表现；3）Multi‑Agent Coordination 方向：研究大规模分布式智能体协作，构建 Agent 集群化协作能力；4）Long‑term Memory 方向：研究 Agent 长期记忆、经验内化与自我迭代机制，形成稳定的行为模式与长期决策准则；5）Long‑Horizon 方向：研究长链路、稀疏反馈任务下的持续决策机制，降低长周期执行中的能力衰减；
5.包括但不限于以下工程方向：1）Harness Self‑Evolution 方向：搭建 Agent 自进化 SDK 与平台，实现智能体自主迭代与持续能力升级；2）Context Engineering 方向：优化 Agent 上下文与提示工程，提升复杂场景下的适配能力与任务表现；3）Evaluation 方向：建设 Agent 多维度评测体系、数据集与基准，支撑 Agent 效果迭代和自进化。

metadata.RecruitPostName: Agent Harness 工程师
metadata.Responsibility:
1.Agent Harness 核心框架研发：负责 Agent 运行时的架构设计与实现，包括 agent loop 调度、Tool/Skill 抽象与注册机制、Context 组装与压缩策略、长任务的状态持久化与 checkpoint 恢复、Sub-Agent 并发编排、以及沙箱隔离与权限控制体系，为上层业务提供稳定、可扩展、可复用的 Agent 执行底座；
2.全链路 Tracing 与 Observability：设计并实现 Agent 执行全链路的可观测系统，对 LLM 调用、工具调用、重试与降级、Token 与成本消耗、上下文膨胀等关键环节做 Span 级建模与结构化埋点；建设延迟/成本/成功率归因分析能力，沉淀 failure mode 分类体系与异常告警机制，让 Agent 的"黑盒行为"可解释、可回溯；
3.Agent 质量评估体系：构建自动化 eval pipeline，覆盖离线 Benchmark、在线 A/B Testing、SBS 人工评测与 regression detection；设计任务级评测指标与 rubric（含 LLM-as-Judge、pass@k、轨迹级评分），建设评测集管理与 CI 门禁，使每次 Prompt、模型、工具变更都有量化的收益与回归判定；
4.Agent Debugging 工具链：开发面向研发的调试工具，支持 Trace 回放与单步执行、上下文与 Prompt 的 Diff 对比、工具调用链可视化、失败样本最小复现集自动提取；打通从线上异常 Trace 到本地可复现调试的闭环，显著缩短 Agent 问题定位周期；
5.支撑平台建设与工程化落地：参与标注平台、数据管道、任务集与轨迹数据仓库等核心支撑平台的架构设计与开发，为模型训练与 Agent 迭代提供高质量数据闭环；与 AI 研究团队零距离协作，第一时间承接最新模型能力，将大模型与 Agent 协同进化的研究成果工程化落地，并持续探索 AI Agent 在日常研发工作流中的深度实践。

2.承接大模型与大数据融合趋势，负责 DataBuddy 智能问数、自然语言转 SQL、语义化分析、智能归因、指标解读、报表自动生成等 AI 应用场景设计；
3.结合腾讯云向量数据库、知识图谱、本体语义能力，优化智能问数准确率、报表自动生成、指标智能解读等核心体验，解决企业“数据看懂难、用起来难、分析门槛高”的核心痛点，打造差异化智能数据应用能力；
4.基于本体建模和语义建模，统一业务语义，让数据先"看得懂、可分析"，再据此支撑智能决策，最终驱动业务动作落地执行，打通"数据分析—智能决策—行动执行"的完整闭环；
5.独立完成需求调研、竞品分析、产品架构设计、原型输出、PRD撰写、需求评审、研发跟进、灰度上线、数据复盘全流程工作。联动研发、算法、测试、解决方案，推进需求落地，持续优化产品功能体验、性能指标、场景覆盖率。同时监控产品核心指标（用户活跃度、自助分析使用率、智能问数通过率、客户交付效率），驱动产品持续迭代优化；
6.对接零售、游戏、教育、汽车等重点行业大客户，挖掘经营分析、数据运营、自助分析等真实需求，完成需求拆解、方案设计、POC 与项目落地；沉淀标准化的行业解决方案、最佳实践与模板资产（行业分析方法论、分析模型、分析模板），支撑售前攻坚与规模化复制；
7.跟踪国内外数据 Agent 行业趋势与竞品动态，提炼 DataBuddy 差异化优势；输出白皮书、方案手册、宣讲材料与教学案例，支撑产品宣发、客户培训与行业落地；
8.该岗位可 base 深圳、北京、上海、杭州。

metadata.RecruitPostName: 腾讯游戏-语音大模型数据策略产品经理-端到端同传
metadata.Responsibility:
1.建设多语种语音大模型（端到端同传、ASR、TTS等）训练数据体系，覆盖中文、英语、阿拉伯语、俄语、土耳其语、泰语、印尼语、越南语等20余个语种。与算法/产品团队协同，评估数据缺口，针对语种特点和模型需求制定数据建设路线与优先级；
2.统筹标注标准和标注资源，定义语音模型高表现力指标，为提升模型在音色多样性、韵律表现、副语言信息、情感表达、表达张力、流式自然度等方面表现提供数据方案；解决多语种在语音同传、翻译场景下的表达习惯、文化适配等问题；
3.建立数据生产规范，搭建智能化数据生产管线，覆盖清洗、预处理、加工、精标、验收等环节，提升中/低资源数据获取效率和质量；主导数据合成、Agent驱动数据生成等智能化数据生产技术的探索和应用，持续生产高质量训练数据，并把控数据合成与采集的合规风险。统筹数据供应商，负责供应商选型、交付标准制定与质量审计；
4.建立主客观结合的数据评价体系，统筹高质量评测集，开展数据质量评估和分析调优。跟踪数据配比与血缘，通过训练效果、离线评测、用户反馈及 Bad Case分析进行模型效果的数据归因，持续优化数据策略、结构与分布；
5.持续关注语音大模型前沿技术发展，沉淀多语种适配经验与数据方法论，形成可复用的标准，持续提升数据生产质量与效率。

detail.RecruitPostName: 安全大模型 / AI Agent 算法工程师
detail.Responsibility:
1.负责面向网络安全场景的大模型与 AI Agent 核心能力研发，包括但不限于安全推理、漏洞分析、自动化渗透测试、威胁分析、代码安全、安全运营等方向，探索 AI 对传统安全能力的重构；
2.负责大模型 Post-training 与 Agent 能力优化，结合 SFT、RL、偏好优化、推理增强、Tool Use、RAG、Memory、Multi-Agent 等技术，持续提升模型在复杂安全任务中的推理、规划、工具调用和自主执行能力；
3.构建高质量安全数据与数据飞轮，从真实业务、漏洞案例、安全专家经验、攻防过程和模型运行轨迹中自动挖掘、清洗和生成训练数据，建立“数据—训练—评测—反馈—迭代”的持续进化闭环；
4.建立面向真实安全任务的大模型 / Agent 评测体系，设计 Benchmark、自动化评测和效果分析方法，从任务成功率、漏洞发现能力、误报率、推理效率、工具调用准确率等维度衡量并持续提升模型能力；
5.跟踪并验证 AI 前沿技术，关注 Foundation Model、Reasoning Model、Agent、RL、Context Engineering、Test-time Scaling 等方向，将前沿研究快速转化为可验证、可落地的安全能力；
6.与安全专家、算法、工程及产品团队紧密合作，将模型能力应用到真实安全业务中，并通过真实场景反馈持续推动算法和系统演进。
detail.Requirement:
1.计算机、人工智能、机器学习、自然语言处理、网络安全或相关专业本科及以上学历，硕士 / 博士优先；
2.具备扎实的大模型基础，对 Transformer、LLM Post-training、推理模型、Agent 等技术有深入理解，并具备实际研发或落地经验；
3.具备较强的动手和实验能力，能够独立完成从问题定义、数据构建、模型训练 / 调优、Benchmark 设计到效果分析的完整研发闭环，而不仅限于模型 API 调用；
4.熟悉至少一个大模型训练与推理技术栈，如 PyTorch、Transformers、vLLM、SGLang、DeepSpeed、Ray 等；具备大规模训练、强化学习或推理优化经验者优先；
5.对 AI Agent 有较深入理解，具备 Tool Use、Function Calling、RAG、Memory、Workflow、Multi-Agent 或 Agent Harness 等相关实践经验者优先；
6.具有较强的问题抽象能力和研究能力，能够快速理解新技术、复现前沿工作，并判断其在真实业务中的价值；
7.对网络安全、漏洞挖掘、渗透测试、代码安全、威胁分析等方向有经验或浓厚兴趣者优先；具备 AI × Security 交叉背景者优先；
8.在 NeurIPS、ICML、ICLR、ACL、EMNLP、USENIX Security、IEEE S&P、CCS、NDSS 等顶级 AI / 安全会议发表过高质量论文，或在开源项目、Benchmark、算法竞赛中有突出成果者优先；
9.具备良好的沟通协作能力和技术判断力，能够与算法、安全专家及工程团队共同解决复杂问题。
detail.DepartmentIntroduction: 腾讯安全平台部成立于2005年，聚焦于腾讯内部安全防护工作，并致力于通过先进技术的应用，构建高效的安全能力协作平台，涉及的领域包含反入侵、漏洞扫描、DDoS防护、流量安全、数据安全、风控安全、安全大数据、AI安全等领域，守护数十亿用户安全，保障腾讯全线业务稳定运营，并积极向业界开放安全经验和能力，推动共建安全生态。在这里，我们用技术聚合向善的力量，不断实现技术人生的追求和梦想。

detail.RecruitPostName: 企业微信-企业客户AI解决方案
detail.Responsibility:
1.客户调研与场景挖掘：深入中腰部客户业务一线，调研真实业务流程与痛点，从中识别能用 AI 解决的高频场景；
2.AI 方案交付落地：基于企业微信+AI能力（智能表格、机器人、workbuddy等）完成方案配置与上线，对使用和转化等交付结果负责；
3.打法沉淀与批量复制：把单点客户的成功打法提炼成标准化方案包和交付SOP，推动中腰同行业客户的高效、批量复制；
4.转化协同：配合网销/商务团队，用AI 场景案例支撑批量转化（商业产出、方案讲解、标杆案例、直播出镜等）；
5.Al 能力反哺：沉淀客户侧高频 AI需求，反哺内部产品与方案迭代。
detail.Requirement:
1.要求；
2.本科及以上学历，2年以上B 端客户成功、解决方案或交付实施经验，有 SaaS/企业服务批量交付经验者优先；
3.有 Al sense：日常高频使用AI工具解决真实工作问题，理解大模型/Agent能力边界，能快速判断结合落地；
4.场景挖掘能力强：能通过访谈和数据分析快速摸清一个陌生行业的业务流程，从杂乱需求中识别共性场景；
5.动手落地能力强：能独立完成产品配置、Prompt调试、简单接口排障，把方案装进客户业务里；
6.多客户并行管理能力强，节奏感好，适应线上线下高频次客户沟通；
7.沟通直接，能把技术语言翻译成客户听得懂的业务语言。
detail.ImportantItem:
1.加分项；
2.会写 Agent Skill / 工作流（如WorkBuddy Skill、Coze/Dify 工作流），能把交付经验封装成可复用的AI能力；
3.有企业微信/微信生态交付或运营经验；
4.有可展示的AI 落地案例（自己用AI做出的真实成果也可）。
